purpose: Diagnostic subset rescore after excluding telephone and meeting minutes; no new model acceptance run.
threshold_policy: Use frozen v13 thresholds for historical replay; show per-scope metrics and critical-error veto separately. P4 protocol completeness is audited independently of its known-broken semantic scorer.
limitations: This is exclusion from diagnostic and current testing scope, not removal of minute-specific code from the extractor.
Removing samples from a denominator does not undo past prompts, tuning, or model calls.
Historical v13 gold and current P3-I gold have different item boundaries and must not be merged.
A passing historical subset metric would not certify current R2, relations, full documents, or CLI integration.
